exodus.19.p1.b1.text: In the third month, on the same day of the month that the Israelites had left the land of Egypt, they came to the Wilderness of Sinai.

exodus.19.p1.b2.text: and Israel camped there in front of the mountain.

exodus.19.p1.b3.text: Then Moses went up to God,

exodus.19.p1.b4.text: This is what you are to tell the house of Jacob and explain to the sons of Israel:

exodus.19.p2.b5.text: ‘You have seen for yourselves what I did to Egypt, and how I carried you on eagles’ wings and brought you to Myself.

exodus.19.p2.b6.text: Now if you will indeed obey My voice and keep My covenant, you will be My treasured possession out of all the nations—for the whole earth is Mine.

exodus.19.p2.b7.text: And unto Me you shall be a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.

exodus.19.p3.b8.text: So Moses went back and summoned the elders of the people and set before them all these words that the LORD had commanded him.

exodus.19.p3.b9.text: We will do everything that the LORD has spoken.

exodus.19.p3.b10.text: So Moses brought their words back to the LORD.

exodus.19.p3.b11.text: Behold, I will come to you in a dense cloud, so that the people will hear when I speak with you, and they will always put their trust in you.

exodus.19.p4.b12.text: Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow. They must wash their clothes and be prepared by the third day, for on the third day the LORD will come down on Mount Sinai in the sight of all the people.

exodus.19.p4.b13.text: Be careful not to go up on the mountain or touch its base… Only when the ram’s horn sounds a long blast may they approach the mountain.

exodus.19.p4.b14.text: When Moses came down from the mountain to the people, he consecrated them, and they washed their clothes.

exodus.19.p4.b15.text: Be prepared for the third day,

exodus.19.p5.b16.text: On the third day, when morning came, there was thunder and lightning. A thick cloud was upon the mountain, and a very loud blast of the ram’s horn went out, so that all the people in the camp trembled.

exodus.19.p5.b17.text: Then Moses brought the people out of the camp to meet with God, and they stood at the foot of the mountain.

exodus.19.p6.b18.text: Mount Sinai was completely enveloped in smoke, because the LORD had descended on it in fire. And the smoke rose like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked violently.

exodus.19.p6.b19.text: And as the sound of the ram’s horn grew louder and louder,

exodus.19.p6.b20.text: Moses spoke and God answered him in the thunder.

exodus.19.p7.b21.text: The LORD descended to the top of Mount Sinai and called Moses to the summit. So Moses went up,

exodus.19.p7.b22.text: Go down and warn the people not to break through to see the LORD, lest many of them perish…

exodus.19.p7.b23.text: The people cannot come up Mount Sinai, for You solemnly warned us, ‘Put a boundary around the mountain and set it apart as holy.’

exodus.19.p7.b24.text: So Moses went down to the people and spoke to them.
